verdict.rationale: Langfuse explicitly documents a Blob Storage Export feature for exporting large volumes of traces/datasets on a schedule, plus Metrics API v2 and SDK-based querying for programmatic data access, supporting warehouse/blob-storage export workflows. Community evidence corroborates that self-hosted/open-source deployments allow direct DB access for bulk operations, though one user noted the bulk retrieval API can be slow. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification specifically of blob storage export (vs. just docs) and more detail on supported destinations/formats.
